name: quick-taps-658
description: How often are direct penalty and 20 m taps taken early, what is the first-play gain and line-break rate by origin, and how do they compare with ordinary taps? The default and disabled variant replay the same seeds in historical whole matches with two seven-minute halves. Neutral flat 60 measures the §7 match totals, while Rush provides a second sample with more ruck offsides. The harness normalizes legacy event totals to five minutes. Multiply the unrounded count means in results by 14/5 for the historical §7 comparison and read completion directly.
